newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to meet constitutional court head.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to meet constitutional court head.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin, who is recovering from pneumonia, will meet constitutional court head Vladimir Tumanov on Thursday, but a Kremlin spokesman could not say where the meeting would take place.

Yeltsin, 65, left hospital 10 days ago after treatment for pneumonia. He has visited the Kremlin twice in just over a week, but has spent most of the time recovering in the Gorky-9 residence outside Moscow.

Interfax news agency quoted presidential press spokesman Sergei Yastrzembsky as saying that Yeltsin and Tumanov would discuss ways to strengthen the role of the constitutional court and of Russia's state structures.
Yeltsin was shown on television on Tuesday for the first time since he fell ill with pneumonia, although it was hard to judge his health from a heavily edited clip with no sound track.
He has spent only a few days in the Kremlin since he won a second term in office last July. He was ill first with heart problems and then with pneumonia.
